sources.title: Official Journal: Decree No. 2299/PR/PM/MSPI/2025 on admission of foreigners
sources.publisher: Official Journal / General Secretariat of Government, Republic of Chad
sources.officialityEvidence: The Official Journal’s official URL identifies Decree No. 2299/PR/PM/MSPI/2025, dated 10 September 2025, governing foreigner admission, CEMAC movement, bilateral visa-exemption agreements and eVisa issuance. The primary PDF was unavailable from its host during this review, so its scope must be re-opened before promotion.
sources.supportingExcerpt: les ressortissants des pays membres peuvent librement entrer sur le territoire de l'un des États membres, y séjourner et en sortir.

sources.title: CEMAC: Member States
sources.publisher: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: CEMAC’s official Commission website identifies the six current member States, allowing Chad’s five foreign Member-State ordinary-passport codes to be mapped.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Cameroun, le Congo, le Gabon, la Guinée Équatoriale, la République de Centrafrique et le Tchad.

sources.title: CEMAC Commission President interview on free movement
sources.publisher: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: The current CEMAC Commission account directly says visa-free free movement for Member-State citizens is effective.
sources.supportingExcerpt: L’effectivité de la libre circulation des citoyens des pays membres de la CEMAC, sans visa, est une réalité indéniable.

sources.title: Common Convention on free movement and right of establishment
sources.publisher: Economic and Monetary Community of Central Africa
sources.officialityEvidence: CEMAC publishes the Common Convention in its official legal archive. Its free-movement provisions cover Union Member-State nationals travelling as tourists and specify document and three-month conditions.
sources.supportingExcerpt: La libre circulation de ces personnes comporte le droit de se déplacer et de séjourner ... pendant une durée de 3 mois

policies.title: Foreign CEMAC ordinary passports: Chad visa-free short-visitor entry
policies.summary: Chad’s current admission decree states that CEMAC Member-State nationals may freely enter, stay in and leave a Member State under the Common Convention. The current CEMAC roster maps the five foreign codes. The same decree separately preserves unnamed bilateral visa-exemption agreements, so this policy does not infer other exemptions or an eVisa complement.
conditions: Applies only to citizens holding ordinary passports of the five other current CEMAC Member States: Cameroon, the Republic of the Congo, Gabon, Equatorial Guinea and the Central African Republic.

For tourism, the published Convention describes a stay up to three months and requires a valid or recently expired national identity card or passport and an international health booklet. The current CEMAC confirmation does not independently restate the duration; verify the Convention’s continuing implementation before relying on that limit.

Entry remains subject to applicable border, health, public-order, security and individual-admissibility controls. It does not establish work, residence, transit, crew, diplomatic, official, service, refugee or special-document treatment.
Decree No. 2299 also recognizes bilateral visa-exemption agreements but publishes no list. Its electronic-visa rules therefore cannot safely be applied to an inferred residual nationality cohort.
